lineage.strategy: Shift from product-award evidence to current realized financial performance, mix pressure, cash generation and updated guidance.

observations.fact: Mobileye reported Q2 2026 revenue of $508 million, roughly flat year over year, while six-month revenue reached $1.066 billion versus $944 million a year earlier.
Mobileye raised and narrowed full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $1.970-$2.020 billion, implying 4%-7% year-over-year growth, and generated $210 million of operating cash flow in the first six months.
Q2 GAAP gross margin fell to 46% from 50%, with lower EyeQ ASP tied mainly to higher China OEM export volumes and a greater SuperVision mix with higher hardware content.

risks.risk: Flat quarterly revenue and lower ASP/gross margin show mix and pricing pressure even as the annual outlook improved; part of operating-income improvement reflects an R&D incentive grant rather than purely operating leverage.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not quantify realized economics from the newly awarded DMS program or future robotaxi/physical-AI programs; those remain forward execution items.

recommendation: Use realized revenue, cash flow, margin mix and updated guidance as current underwriting inputs; separate grant-driven profitability effects from recurring operating improvement.
